meta.name: How To Get To Heaven From Belfast
meta.description: Three lifelong pals embark on a chaotic quest to solve the mystery of their old friend's suspicious death and keep their own dark secret under wraps.

videos.title: The Wake
videos.overview: Old pals Dara, Robyn and Saoirse head to a small Donegal town for a school friend's wake, and to make sure a long-held secret stays buried.

videos.title: The Secret
videos.overview: Reeling from the crash, the gang vows to leave Greta and the past well alone, until mysterious red letters and an old notebook pull them right back in.

videos.title: The Ghost
videos.overview: As a storm rages towards Knockdara, Saoirse, Dara and Robyn set up camp in the hotel, again. Liam probes deeper into another old friend of Greta's.

videos.title: The Girl from Sagres
videos.overview: After some stellar sleuthing, the trio's search for answers takes them to a five-star resort in Portugal, where they're not the only ones on a mission.

videos.title: The Box
videos.overview: Desperate to outrun Booker, the three friends scramble around St Patrick's Day Dublin. After Andrew's bombshell, Liam has a bone to pick with Saoirse.

videos.title: Separate But Inseparable
videos.overview: Already in a tight spot, a confession ratchets up the tension between Robyn, Saoirse, and Dara. An exasperated Booker gets back on the box's trail.

videos.title: Outlaws, Liars and Fallen Angels
videos.overview: Booker, Feeney and the Midwife receive a summons to Derry. At a Belfast police station, risky gambits, surprise reunions and smoke breaks transpire.

videos.title: Anagnorisis
videos.overview: Having come this far, Saoirse, Dara and Robyn know there's no going back. Will they finally uncover the terrifying truth ... and manage to stay alive?
